title: Finite support composition with the identity is the canonical unitor
statement: For a finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $C$, finite coefficient field $E$, positive integer $n$, and the specified finite operations $S$ of [def-sf-operation-stages], use the identity compactification and canonical finite comparison $v:I\simeq\mathrm{id}$ of [def-sf-identity-coefficient-transport-data]. For every separated finite-type $D.k$-scheme $X$, compactification $c$ of its structure morphism $a$, and object $K$ of the bounded constructible finite coefficient category, the actual specified compositor satisfies $\alpha_{\mathrm{id}_s,a,K}=v_{Ra_!K}$. No assertion about exceptional adjoints, counits, or changes of coefficient is made.

source.place: Normalized trace sentence; agent expansion in lem-sf-identification-coefficient-transport, steps 1--7.

proof.text: Retain an etale-origin witness for the bounded constructible input, and apply the finite operation datum's composition normalization at (a,id_s), transporting the composite compactification by comp_id. The specified comparison is the witnessed origin compositor under the supplied operation realizations.

Apply the right-identity clause of originComposition. Substitute the witnessed realizations, cancel their inverse pairs and the compactification transport. The finite proper normalization and the direct-image identity identify the remaining unitor with the canonical finite comparison.

Cancel the retained witness isomorphism and reflect the resulting equality through the fully faithful bounded constructible inclusion. The origin right-unit identity is on all bounded constructible inputs, so no finite-Tor condition is needed.
